designPillars: Bedrock: multiple characters playable in the same game world without breaking anything. Every mod is screened for player-bound state (player-alias scripts, quest variables keyed to the player, per-character needs/skill/appearance state) and must tolerate character switching.
Scale: 1000-2000 plugins; replace vanilla content broadly with diverse, quality, high-performance assets; prefer rule-driven systems (KID/BOS/SkyPatcher) that absorb asset churn.
Survival: comprehensive and in-depth with zero tedium, no save restrictions.
